api_endpoint.description: Endpoint of the Sneller API (intended for internal use).

default_region.description: Default AWS region to use. It defaults to the SNELLER_REGION environment variable. If this variable isn't set, then it default to us-east-1

token.description: Sneller token to authenticate to the Sneller API. It defaults to the SNELLER_TOKEN environment variable.

block.description: Terraform provider for interacting with Sneller.

index.description: Configures an Elastic index that maps to a Sneller table.

location.description: Location of the Elastic proxy configuration file (i.e. `s3://sneller-cache-bucket/db/elastic-proxy.json`).

log_preprocessed.description: Log preprocessed Sneller results (may be verbose and contain sensitive data).

log_result.description: Log result (may be verbose and contain sensitive data).

log_sneller_result.description: Log Sneller query result (may be verbose and contain sensitive data).

log_path.description: Location where Elastic Proxy logging is stored (i.e. `s3://logging-bucket/elastic-proxy/`). Make sure Sneller is allowed to write to this S3 bucket.

region.description: Region for which to configure the Elastic Proxy. If not set, then the configuration is assumed to be located in the tenant's home region.

beta_features.description: List of feature flags that can be used to turn on features for beta-testing.

allow_empty.description: Allow empty values (only valid for strings) to be ingested. If flag is set to false, then the field won't be written for the record instead.

default.description: Default value if the column is an empty string

false_values.description: Optional list of values that represent FALSE (only valid for bool type).

missing_values.description: Optional list of values that represents a missing value.

name.description: Field-name (use dots to make it a subfield)

no_index.description: ADon't use sparse-indexing for this value (only valid for date-time type).

true_values.description: Optional list of values that represent TRUE (only valid for bool type).

missing_values.description: list of values that represent a missing value.

skip_records.description: skip the first *N* records (useful when headers are used).

pattern.description: Pattern definition to specify the source pattern (i.e. `s3://sneller-source-bucket/data/*.ndjson`).

allow_empty.description: Allow empty values (only valid for strings) to be ingested. If flag is set to false, then the field won't be written for the record instead.

default.description: Default value if the column is an empty string

false_values.description: Optional list of values that represent FALSE (only valid for bool type).

missing_values.description: Optional list of values that represents a missing value.

name.description: Field-name (use dots to make it a subfield)

inputs.description: The input definition specifies where the source data is located and it format.

location.description: S3 url of the database location (i.e. `s3://sneller-cache-bucket/db/test-db/test-table/`).

field.description: Name of the partition field. If this field conflicts with a field in the input data, the partition field will override it.

value.description: Template string that is used to produce the value for the partition field. If this is empty (or not set), the field name is used to determine the input URI part that will be used to determine the value.

partitions.description: Synthetic field that is generated from parts of an input URI and used to partition table data..

region.description: Region where the table should be created. If not set, then the table is created in the tenant's home region.

field.description: Path expression for the field used to determine the age of a record for the purpose of the data retention policy. Currently only timestamp fields are supported.

valid_for.description: ValidFor is the validity window relative to now. This is a string with a format like `<n>y<n>m<n>d` where `<n>` is a number and any component can be omitted.

retention_policy.description: Synthetic field that is generated from parts of an input URI and used to partition table data.

skip_backfill.description: Skip scanning the source bucket(s) for matching objects when the first objects are inserted into the table.

effective_max_scan_bytes.description: Effective maximum number of bytes scanned per query

external_id.description: External ID (typically the same as the tenant ID) that is passed when assuming the IAM role

max_scan_bytes.description: Maximum number of bytes scanned per query

prefix.description: Prefix of the files in the Sneller cache bucket (always 'db/').

region.description: Region from which to fetch the tenant configuration. When not set, then it default's to the tenant's home region.

role_arn.description: ARN of the role that is used to access the S3 data in this region's cache bucket. It is also used by the ingestion process to read the source data.

sqs_arn.description: ARN of the SQS resource that is used to signal the ingestion process when new data arrives.

is_admin.description: Flag indicating whether the user is an administrator.

is_enabled.description: Flag indicating whether the user is enabled.

is_federated.description: Flag indicating whether the user is using an federated identity provider.

database.description: Database to fetch. When not set, then it default's to the tenant's home region.

tables.description: Set of tables in the specified database.
